protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed from the BIC, v0.8.0, v1.14.0, and origin/main trees: attacker-controlled weight_map shard names are passed to os.path.join(checkpoint_folder, f) without containment validation, so ../ escapes and absolute names discard the checkpoint folder before the resulting path is opened. Current load_state_dict uses safetensors.safe_open or torch.load(..., weights_only=True), supporting the advisory's file-read/parse-oracle and FIFO-denial-of-service scope rather than RCE.
